report.explanation: All 12 checkout observations returned HTTP 200 with durations 63-172ms; gateway metrics show 32 successful /v1/checkout requests and zero 502s in 60s. Traces show healthy sub-second spans across order, payment, inventory, redis and postgres. No error, saturation, or latency anomaly is established, so no public cause is supported. Logs were excluded and dependency metrics are empty; hand off for further evidence rather than assert a fault.
